title: Une journée difficile
summary_en: Antoine's Monday goes wrong from the very first minute: no alarm, a missed bus, rain and a forgotten wallet. Will anything go right?

sentences.fr: Lundi matin, le réveil n'a pas sonné.
sentences.en: Monday morning, the alarm clock did not ring.

sentences.fr: Antoine s'est réveillé à huit heures vingt.
sentences.en: Antoine woke up at eight twenty.

sentences.fr: Il avait une réunion importante à neuf heures.
sentences.en: He had an important meeting at nine o'clock.

sentences.fr: Il a regardé le réveil : il était cassé !
sentences.en: He looked at the alarm clock: it was broken!

sentences.fr: « Oh non ! » a crié Antoine.
sentences.en: “Oh no!” shouted Antoine.

sentences.fr: Il s'est habillé en trois minutes et il est sorti de la maison.
sentences.en: He got dressed in three minutes and left the house.

sentences.fr: Sa journée commençait très mal.
sentences.en: His day was starting very badly.

sentences.fr: Au coin de la rue, il a vu son bus partir.
sentences.en: At the corner of the street, he saw his bus leave.

sentences.fr: Antoine a couru, mais le bus est parti sans lui.
sentences.en: Antoine ran, but the bus left without him.

sentences.fr: Il a attendu le prochain bus pendant dix minutes.
sentences.en: He waited for the next bus for ten minutes.

sentences.fr: Alors la pluie a commencé à tomber.
sentences.en: Then the rain started to fall.

sentences.fr: La pluie était forte.
sentences.en: The rain was heavy.

sentences.fr: Antoine n'avait pas de parapluie.
sentences.en: Antoine did not have an umbrella.

sentences.fr: Il était mouillé et il avait froid.
sentences.en: He was wet and he was cold.

sentences.fr: « Quelle journée ! » a pensé Antoine.
sentences.en: “What a day!” thought Antoine.

sentences.fr: Enfin, un autre bus est arrivé.
sentences.en: At last, another bus arrived.

sentences.fr: Antoine a voulu acheter un billet.
sentences.en: Antoine wanted to buy a ticket.

sentences.fr: Il a cherché son portefeuille dans son sac.
sentences.en: He looked for his wallet in his bag.

sentences.fr: Il n'était pas là !
sentences.en: It was not there!

sentences.fr: Antoine a oublié son portefeuille sur la table de la cuisine.
sentences.en: Antoine forgot his wallet on the kitchen table.

sentences.fr: Sans portefeuille, il n'avait pas d'argent pour le billet.
sentences.en: Without a wallet, he had no money for the ticket.

sentences.fr: Le chauffeur a regardé Antoine sans sourire.
sentences.en: The driver looked at Antoine without smiling.

sentences.fr: Antoine est devenu tout rouge.
sentences.en: Antoine turned all red.

sentences.fr: Une jeune femme a souri.
sentences.en: A young woman smiled.

sentences.fr: « Je vais payer votre billet », a dit la jeune femme.
sentences.en: “I am going to pay for your ticket,” said the young woman.

sentences.fr: « Merci, madame ! Vous êtes très gentille ! » a dit Antoine.
sentences.en: “Thank you, madam! You are very kind!” said Antoine.

sentences.fr: À neuf heures dix, Antoine est entré dans le bureau.
sentences.en: At ten past nine, Antoine walked into the office.

sentences.fr: Il était en retard, mouillé et fatigué.
sentences.en: He was late, wet and tired.

sentences.fr: Il a pris un café à la machine.
sentences.en: He got a coffee from the machine.

sentences.fr: Son collègue Paul l'a appelé.
sentences.en: His colleague Paul called him.

sentences.fr: Antoine s'est retourné trop vite.
sentences.en: Antoine turned around too fast.

sentences.fr: Il a renversé son café sur sa chemise blanche.
sentences.en: He spilled his coffee on his white shirt.

sentences.fr: « Oh non, pas ma chemise ! » a dit Antoine.
sentences.en: “Oh no, not my shirt!” said Antoine.

sentences.fr: Tout le monde a ri, et Antoine aussi.
sentences.en: Everyone laughed, and Antoine too.

sentences.fr: Heureusement, la réunion n'a pas commencé.
sentences.en: Luckily, the meeting did not start.

sentences.fr: Le patron était en retard, lui aussi, à cause de la pluie.
sentences.en: The boss was late too, because of the rain.

sentences.fr: La jeune femme du bus est entrée dans la salle de réunion.
sentences.en: The young woman from the bus came into the meeting room.

sentences.fr: C'était la nouvelle collègue !
sentences.en: She was the new colleague!

sentences.fr: Elle a regardé la chemise d'Antoine et elle a souri.
sentences.en: She looked at Antoine's shirt and smiled.

sentences.fr: « Je m'appelle Camille. Je vais vous offrir un autre café », a dit Camille.
sentences.en: “My name is Camille. I am going to buy you another coffee,” said Camille.

sentences.fr: Antoine a ri.
sentences.en: Antoine laughed.

sentences.fr: « Demain, je vais acheter un nouveau réveil ! » a dit Antoine.
sentences.en: “Tomorrow, I am going to buy a new alarm clock!” said Antoine.

sentences.fr: C'était une journée difficile, mais elle finissait bien.
sentences.en: It was a difficult day, but it was ending well.

o.en: The alarm clock did not ring

quiz.why: The alarm clock was broken and did not ring on Monday morning.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce qu'Antoine oublie à la maison ?
quiz.q_en: What does Antoine forget at home?
quiz.why: He left his wallet on the kitchen table.
A young woman smiled and said she would pay for his ticket.

quiz.q: Pourquoi Antoine veut-il acheter un nouveau réveil ?
quiz.q_en: Why does Antoine want to buy a new alarm clock?
quiz.why: His alarm clock was broken, which started his bad day.
